text: The original warning test asserts isVisible but says the warning should be hidden. Its enabled-Graph case also asserts visibility while saying unavailable by default. The accepted tests now say visible and available respectively. Preserve those later diagnostic corrections separately from the original migration. The issue is the opposite expected state, beyond the presence of should in each message.
title: Account Hub visibility assertions need wording that matches the tested state
